WHAT IS NOT IN THIS DRAWING
cooling tower, pond or river intake
gearbox, oil system or blade cooling
Doppler shuts the core down, 150–250 t of graphite buys hours, and the air RCCS carries the rest away indefinitely.
Peak fuel ~1,240 °C in normal operation against a 1,600 °C TRISO limit — 360 °C of margin, with no operator action, no power and no water.
